config.title: Around the World
config.finalMessage: Head back to the meeting room

countries.name: Japan
countries.grid:

countries.clue: Cross out the letters of the 3 countries in the pictures (tap a letter to cross it). Rearrange the letters that are left to find your next destination.
countries.hint: The leftover letters spell a famous dish.
countries.challenge: Sushi Sticks: the whole team stands on the wooden log and passes the sushi rolls to the plate using the sticks. Anyone who steps off the log, start that roll again.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.clue: Each number is a letter. Decode the two words.
countries.challenge: Desert Caravan: one blindfolded teammate crosses a cone "desert" guided only by the team's voices. Touching a cone costs 10 points.

countries.name: Spain
countries.clue: Use the icon key to decode one of my famous dishes.
countries.answers: paella, spain, españa, espana, اسبانيا, إسبانيا
countries.challenge: Ribbon Stand: each player holds one strap and swirls together until the ribbon is fully unfolded.

countries.name: France
countries.clue: Slide the transparent dots sheet onto the text until it fits exactly. The letters under the dots spell a message: which country speaks it?
countries.challenge: 72-Piece Puzzle: look at the picture for 30 seconds only, then the team builds the 72-piece puzzle from memory.

countries.name: India
countries.clue: 🎧 You are on the plane and the captain plays this music. Listen: which country is your flight heading to?
countries.challenge: Bollywood Dance: learn the Bollywood dance and perform it together as a team.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.clue: Break the code to find your next destination.
countries.answers: south africa, southafrica, جنوب افريقيا, جنوب أفريقيا
countries.hint: Home of the Big Five safari animals.
countries.challenge: Animal Hunt: shoot the animal targets using the bow and arrows.
